  (hne : p ≠ q) : p * q > max p q := by cases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with
  | inl h =>
    rw [max_eq_right (le_of_lt h)]
    have hp_ge_two := prime_ge_two p hp
    nlinarith

    rw [max_eq_left (le_of_lt h)]
    have hq_ge_two := prime_ge_two q hq
